verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a sandbox that mirrors production but runs on test data, so integrations can be validated 'without financial risk' (bvnk-docs-31, bvnk-docs-28). It also provides a dedicated simulation endpoint (POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation) for pay-ins and payouts across currencies and payment methods (bvnk-docs-3, bvnk-docs-22). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, and documentation of how sandbox credentials and endpoints are kept separate from production.
